description: tiktok: Search by Keyword (keyword pages). GET /v1/tiktok/search/keyword. Get TikTok videos for a phrase from TikTok's public keyword page for it (tiktok.com/discover/<phrase>), 16 per page, as search_item_list of aweme_info objects (aweme_id, desc, create_time, author, statistics, video, music). The phrase is turned into the page's slug ("how to tie a tie" → how-to-tie-a-tie). Videos only: no accounts, hashtags or sounds. This covers only phrases TikTok has a keyword page for: most multi- Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cursor.description: The cursor string from the previous page's response ("<offset>:<session id>", such as 16:2026111707043796BD7F5020338800F556). It keeps later pages from repeating earlier ones; any other value returns 400

date_posted.description: Accepted for compatibility but ignored: keyword pages cannot be filtered by date

query.description: The phrase to look up, as words (how to tie a tie) or as the keyword page's slug (how-to-tie-a-tie)

region.description: Accepted for compatibility but ignored: results are read as a US visitor

sort_by.description: Accepted for compatibility but ignored: results keep the keyword page's order

trim.description: Set to true to get a trimmed response

name: tiktok_search_keyword
